instruction: Using Obsidian, search for every note containing "mint-rollup" and write the absolute paths of all matching notes to "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_search_4.txt", listing each path on its own line.

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Mint Notes

The mint-rollup should include the weekly summary and open questions.
'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Mint Notes.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Mint Ideas

Maybe the mint-rollup becomes a Friday checklist.
'); obsidian-cli create "Inbox/Mint Ideas.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Q2 Notes

Still shaping the release checklist.
'); obsidian-cli create "Projects/Q2 Notes.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_search_4.txt"
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
vault = Path(r'''/Users/pipiwu/Documents/Benchmark/Benchmark''')
query = r'''mint-rollup'''
for path in sorted(vault.rglob('*.md')):
    rel = str(path.relative_to(vault))
    out = subprocess.run(['obsidian-cli', 'print', rel, '--vault', 'Benchmark'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode == 0 and query in out.stdout:
        print(path)
PY
